approved_terminology.Personalized Index: Personalized Physiological Strain Index (0 - 100, relative to resting baseline)
approved_terminology.Recovery Trajectory: Projected Autonomic Recovery Trajectory (heuristic exponential decay based on baseline HRV)
approved_terminology.Dataset Labels: Laboratory TSST Protocol Condition Labels (Experimental ground truth)

output_definitions.mathematical_definition: Downstream calibrated probability output by XGBoost classifier from 788-D fused NormWear representation + 20-D explicit features.
output_definitions.ground_truth_status: Supervised against WESAD laboratory Trier Social Stress Test (TSST) arithmetic/speech condition labels.
output_definitions.scientific_limitations: Measures physiological autonomic reactivity elicited under experimental laboratory stress conditions; DOES NOT constitute a clinical psychological stress assessment.
output_definitions.disallowed_interpretation: 'User is clinically stressed' or 'User has an anxiety disorder'.

output_definitions.mathematical_definition: Blended score: clip(100 * (0.60 * P(stress) + 0.40 * dev_prob), 0, 100), where dev_prob is the sigmoid of multi-modal baseline Z-scores (HR, RMSSD, EDA, Temp, embedding distance).
output_definitions.ground_truth_status: Heuristic composite score normalized relative to each individual's resting baseline setpoint.
output_definitions.scientific_limitations: Relative personal indicator. Physiological strain can also be induced by physical exertion, caffeine, temperature shifts, or acute excitement.
output_definitions.disallowed_interpretation: 'Medical severity grade' or 'Diagnosis of cardiovascular distress'.

output_definitions.mathematical_definition: Proportional decomposition of standardized feature deviations (EDA Z-score, HR Z-score, RMSSD drop Z-score, vasoconstriction Z-score, embedding drift).
output_definitions.scientific_limitations: Shows which physiological sensor channels departed most significantly from resting baseline; does NOT prove external real-world causality (e.g. 'work caused this').

output_definitions.mathematical_definition: Exponential decay model: Strain(t) = Strain_0 * exp(-t / (tau_0 / vagal_factor)), calibrated by personal resting RMSSD.
output_definitions.scientific_limitations: Theoretical projection under quiet resting conditions. Ongoing cognitive or physical demands will alter real-world trajectory.
